blocks.text: This note represents a constituent sub-component of migrated-schemes-scheme-85. For the unified examination framework, refer to the parent master note.

items: Launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs on 4th January 2021, this program extends
the PM SVANidhi scheme to assess street vendors' eligibility for eight welfare schemes.
